ideas.pitch: An augmented reality indoor navigation app built specifically for complex university buildings to help freshers and visitors find classes instantly.
ideas.title: CampusNav-AR: Real-time Indoor Navigation for CU Campuses
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a massive localized pain point for Chandigarh University students, making it instantly relatable to on-site judges who navigate the campus daily.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered dashboard for university mess operators that forecasts student attendance and dietary preferences using historical data to minimize food waste.
ideas.title: Mess-AI: Predictive Food Waste and Menu Optimization Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical sustainability with operational cost-saving, a metric university administration and student judges deeply care about.

ideas.pitch: A localized evaluation pipeline that checks student code and project reports for both traditional plagiarism and complex AI-generated logic patterns.
ideas.title: PeerProof: AI-Driven Plagiarism and AI-Content Shield for Student Submissions
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an urgent evaluation bottleneck faced by professors and student-led hackathons alike, leveraging advanced localized ML models.

ideas.pitch: A geo-tagged reporting and dispatch platform that automates maintenance request routing for university hostels using priority-scoring algorithms.
ideas.title: HostelMaint: Smart Ticketing and Resource Allocation for University Hostels
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets everyday student life friction points with an immediately demoable dashboard and clear workflow execution.

ideas.pitch: An onboarding web app that analyzes developer portfolios and GitHub profiles to auto-assemble balanced hackathon teams based on complementary skill sets.
ideas.title: SkillSync CU: Automated Team Formation and Skill-Gap Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Meta-hackathon utility that solves the exact problem faced by attendees at large-scale events like HackOphobia looking to form teams instantly.
